summary: Servers with --max-parallel-prefills 2 or more no longer stop generating when all running slots hold long prompts and more requests wait
compatibility: No user action required. Affected only servers started with --max-parallel-prefills 2 or more (or auto). The profiles keep 1, the default.
details: What was wrong: prefill lanes went to never-scheduled requests first, including queued requests that could not be admitted because every running slot (--max-num-seqs) was taken or new requests were paused. The running requests that were still prefilling long prompts got no lane.

Consequence: every step scheduled nothing. Running stayed at max-num-seqs with requests waiting, the GPUs idled, and generation stopped for good without an error. netwalker4370 hit it on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 with --max-parallel-prefills 2 and 40 concurrent 150K-token prompts at --max-num-seqs 32.
Now queued requests compete for prefill lanes only while one of them can be admitted. Reported, with the root cause and this fix, by netwalker4370.
